Accuracy is Questionable. The app is generally well designed. Unfortunately, many of the the questions and multiple choice answers are so poorly written that the “correct” answer doesn’t make grammatical sense, which makes it look like an incorrect answer. Then some “correct” answers are just flat out inaccurate. As in, clearly in direct contradiction to the CDL manual, and also mechanical reality. 

To make that situation worse, there’s no built in mechanism to report errors to the app developer when you come across them. 

In general, it’s been a helpful study tool, but the errors have me lacking confidence that it’s helping me learn the correct answers for the test.
